issues.description: The plan is hashed via pin(), then parsed by an independent read_bytes() call. Final plan recheck occurs after create_commit, so the exact hashed bytes are not necessarily the parsed plan used for mutation.
issues.required_change: Read stable canonical regular-file bytes once, derive both pin and parsed plan from that snapshot, and re-pin the plan immediately before create_commit.

issues.description: pin() uses O_NOFOLLOW for the final component but does not require a regular file or canonical absolute parent path.
issues.required_change: Require stat.S_ISREG and canonical absolute paths, preserving no-follow leaf reads and before/after identity checks.

method: Manual source read and AST syntax only; publisher not invoked.
passed_source_invariants: Exact dataset identity and authenticated Publicus admin account required.
Expected parent compared at initial read and immediately before commit; create_commit supplies parent_commit.
Existing remote identities recorded at pinned parent and preserved except two explicit mutable paths.
Addition paths restricted to the named release prefix, unique, and unoccupied unless one of two explicit mutable pointers.
Local payload byte sizes and SHA256 pins checked before mutation and after verification.
Observed successful create_commit OID stored in state and commit-observed.json before remote verification.
LFS SHA256 and byte size verified; small Git payloads downloaded at exact commit and canonical cache-blob SHA256 checked.
Closed receipt retains partial external effects if verification fails.
